news.title: 'It's coming home': Meet the England players at the power football world cup
news.lede: Tomorrow is the final of the 2026 FIPFA Powerchair Football World Cup. After five days of footballing action England sit comfortably in first place, and will be headed to the final, if they can beat the US today. Also known as power football or wheelchair football, it sees two teams of four-a-side players compete using powerchairs with front bumpers. BBC Sport's Ellis Palmer went to meet the England players before the tournament kicked off.

news.title: FIFA: Azerbaijan is ready for World Cup
news.lede: Preparations for the FIFA U-15 World Cup and Festival, which will be hosted by Azerbaijan, have been completed, FIFA posted on its social media account, Apasport.az reports. In its post about the tournament to be held in Baku, football's governing body stated that the Hovsan Competition Complex had been made ready. "This complex was built by AFFA in just 66 days. Azerbaijan is ready for the FIFA U-15 World Cup and Festival," the post stated.

news.title: Lionel Scaloni signs new Argentina deal until the 2030 World Cup
news.lede: Lionel Scaloni has agreed to extend his contract as Argentina head coach until the end of the 2030 World Cup, according to Cesar Luis Melo. Scaloni has ended speculation about his future following an emotionally demanding period leading the national team. The Argentine Football Association (AFA) has reached a full agreement with Scaloni to prolong his stay beyond December 2026, when his former contract was due to expire. The decision is a significant boost for Argentina as they will retain the coach who led them to the 2022 World Cup and ended the country’s 36-year wait for football’s biggest prize.

news.title: Football’s enduring controversies show why journalism matters
news.lede: Investigative journalism exposed FIFA President Gianni Infantino’s proposed FIFA Forward Enterprise, a commercial venture valued at $20 billion. Media reporting revealed the proposal before FIFA made a public announcement, prompting widespread criticism and the plan’s subsequent withdrawal. Journalism holds powerful institutions accountable by investigating decisions, verifying facts and exposing information that might otherwise remain secret. Artificial intelligence relies on information created and verified by people, making professional journalism essential to the reliability of AI-generated answers.

news.title: Guam to compete in FIFA U15 World Cup and Festival in Azerbaijan
news.lede: Guam’s U15 boys national soccer team will represent the island at the inaugural FIFA U15 World Cup and Festival, taking place Oct. 24-30 in Baku, Azerbaijan. Guam will compete in Group W alongside Uzbekistan, Ghana, Myanmar, the Bahamas and Kazakhstan, giving the island’s young players opportunities to face opponents from different backgrounds and gain valuable international match experience. The historic tournament will unite soccer players from across the world, offering Guam’s players an opportunity to test their skills, experience different styles of play and build connections with teams from diverse football cultures. “This tournament represents a monumental milestone not just for these young men, but for the entire football community in Guåhan as we take part in the inaugural FIFA U15 World Cup and Festival,” said head coach Ross Awa.

news.title: De la Fuente offers the World Cup to the Virgin of Pilar
news.lede: The national football team coach, Luis de la Fuente, offered the World Cup to the Virgin of the Pillar last Monday, October 19, at the Basilica of Our Lady of the Pillar in Zaragoza. According to Iglesia en Aragón, De la Fuente carried the trophy for much of the visit and placed it at the feet of the patroness of the Hispanic world and of Aragon. The event was attended by the Archbishop of Zaragoza, Carlos Escribano, and the Dean of the Metropolitan Chapter, Juan Sebastián Teruel, as well as the president of the Royal Spanish Football Federation, Rafael Louzán, and other representatives of Spanish football. Hundreds of people followed the ceremony inside and outside the church, according to EWTN News.

news.title: The CommBank ParaMatildas defeat Finland 10-0 to advance to the final of the IFCPF Women’s World Cup 2026
news.lede: The CommBank ParaMatildas have defeated Finland 10-0 in the semi-final to advance to the final of the IFCPF Women’s World Cup 2026. Carly Salmon and Annmarie De Uriarte scored four apiece, while Tamsin Colley and Eloise Northam were also on the scoresheet. There was one change to the side that defeated the Netherlands in the final group stage game. Eloise Northam started, wearing the captain’s armband, while Leah Spaine started from the bench.
